Stats: Health: 500
Tags: Damage, SpellDamage, MagicPenetration, ArmorPenetration

[Passive] Hack the Meat: Dealing damage shreds 3 Armor and Magic Resist for 5 seconds, stacking up to 10 times. Applying stacks has a 1 second cooldown per Ability.

[Passive] Cannibalize: On Champion Takedown, steal 10% of their stats and size for the rest of the round.
